---
title: "TKBM262615 Practicals"
---

Lecture notes and hands-on Jupyter notebooks for **TBM263214 Komputasi Biologi** (Computational Biology), Biomedical Engineering, Universitas Gadjah Mada. Every notebook runs directly in [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/); each lecture note carries an *Open In Colab* button for its practical.

## Lecture notes → practicals

| Lecture | Practical notebook(s) |
|---|---|
| L01 — Why Model a Cell? | [01 ODE intro](notebooks/01_ode_intro.ipynb) |
| L02 — The Mathematical Toolkit | [01 ODE intro](notebooks/01_ode_intro.ipynb) |
| L03 — Reaction Networks and Mass Action | [02 Mass action](notebooks/02_mass_action.ipynb), [02 Simple networks](notebooks/02_simple_networks.ipynb) |
| L04 — Conservation and Numerical Simulation | [02 Simple networks](notebooks/02_simple_networks.ipynb) (incl. Euler's method) |
| L05 — Enzyme Kinetics I | [03 Enzyme kinetics I](notebooks/03_enzyme_kinetics_I.ipynb) |
| L06 — Enzyme Kinetics II | [04 Enzyme kinetics II](notebooks/04_enzyme_kinetics_II.ipynb) (incl. Hill fitting) |

Companion repo for the course: [`lab-biotek-bio-ugm/TKBM262615`](https://github.com/lab-biotek-bio-ugm/TKBM262615).
